# COMMITTEE ON BILLS ON SECOND READING
## June 2, 2026 at 6:30 PM

Chairman Trisciani called the meeting to order.

The Clerk called the roll.

Present: Aldermen Trisciani, Terrio, Fajardo, Kantor, Dexter

1. Ordinance Amendments:

"Amending the Code of Ordinances of the City of Manchester by amending §32.029 Funding and Resource Management pertaining to the Art Commission by increasing spending authorization without board approval to $1,000 per project."

*On motion of Alderman Terrio, duly seconded by Alderman Fajardo, it was voted that the Ordinance Amendments ought to pass and be referred to the Committee on Accounts, Enrollment & Revenue Administration.*

"Amending Section 33.081 Sick Leave (D) of the Code of Ordinances of the City of Manchester to change the terms of sick leave use."

Matthew Normand, City Clerk: The Interim HR Director has requested that this Ordinance Amendment be tabled to allow the department to work on the item.

*On motion of Alderman Terrio, duly seconded by Alderman Dexter, it was voted to table.*

*There being no further business, on motion of Alderman Fajardo, duly seconded by Alderman Kantor, it was voted to adjourn.*

A True Record. Attest.

Clerk of Committee

Meeting Start Time: 6:30PM
Meeting End Time: 6:31PM
Minutes Prepared By: Michael Intranuovo
headline: Recommended an Art Commission spending ordinance amendment for referral and tabled a sick leave ordinance amendment.
summary: The committee voted that an ordinance amendment raising Art Commission spending authorization to $1,000 per project ought to pass and referred it to the Committee on Accounts, Enrollment & Revenue Administration. It also voted to table an ordinance amendment changing sick leave terms under Section 33.081(D), at the request of the Interim HR Director.
decisions: Voted that the ordinance amendment to §32.029 (Art Commission spending authorization to $1,000 per project) ought to pass and be referred to the Committee on Accounts, Enrollment & Revenue Administration.
Voted to table the ordinance amendment to Section 33.081 Sick Leave (D).
